scheme_name: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners / Participants Of National/ International Events
other_conditions: Must be a medal winner of National Games or a participant in recognized international sporting events (World University Service, International Olympic Committee, Olympic Council of Asia).

Must be admitted to a university/college/institution covered under sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956, or deemed universities under section 3, or funded by Central/State Government, or Institutes of National Importance.
Subsequent years’ scholarship depends on the sportsperson’s subsequent sports performance.
benefits_summary: Provides full tuition fee coverage, monthly stipend, hostel facilities, and a kit allowance for eligible sportspersons pursuing higher education.
documents_required: Certificate of participation or medal‑winning attested by the Registrar or Principal of the institution
